csp.cspViolations: exactly one script-src-elem entry, for the sibling script (Chromium reports a cross-origin redirected URL by its scheme only, e.g. 'script-src-elem blueline')
csp.why: the inline scripts run ('unsafe-inline') and set data-scripts-ran. The sibling csp-self-inline.js is requested on the <docId> host, redirected (307) to blueline://<docId>-files/ (9.1 Serving), and 'self' does not match that origin, so it is blocked: data-sibling-script-ran stays absent and data-csp-violations names it. Served from one web origin with its files, it would run. The overlay must add no violation of its own (9.1 Preload).
